notes.title: Demo Updated
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

In response to your feedback, we have updated the demo. Changes include an updated start scene, new generating path backgrounds and general bug fixes. We are also excited to announce we are participating in Steam Next Fest starting tomorrow so have a go at our demo. 

YOXE Studios

notes.title: Tides of Lava Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
We are extremely excited to announce the Tides of Lava Demo has been published. Have a play and let us know what you think. 

Cheers 
YOXE Studios.

notes.title: Tides of Lava Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 

A quick update on the progress that has been made over the past couple of weeks. We have three new enemies in the witch, blinker and healer. The witch increases other enemy's armor, the healer is self-explanatory, and the blinker is an enemy that will quickly dash forward every now and then. Furthermore, the tutorial has been implemented, there is now a settings panel, and towers of different levels look different. 

At YOXE Studios, we are extremely excited about the progress being made and hope to have the demo of Tides of Lava released on the 10th of February. Have a great week. 

YOXE Studios.

notes.title: Demo Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

We have pushed back the release of the Tides of Lava demo until mid-February to give us more time to properly polish the game. We apologize for any disappointment caused.

YOXE Studios

notes.title: Demo Release Details
notes.content:
Hello everyone. I am excited to announce that the demo for Tides of Lava will be released mid-January sometime, in time for the next Steam Next Fest! The first demo won't be 100% polished, however, it will be consistently updated between now and the start of the Steam Next Fest. Can't wait to hear everyone's experience playing Tides of Lava. 

Happy New Year
YOXE Studios.
